name: penname-ios
description: Penname for iOS — native shell (Capacitor) around the Penname Mobile web app

scripts.sync: rsync -a ../ios/index.html ../ios/style.css ../ios/app.js ../ios/engine.js ../ios/activity.js ../ios/sw.js ../ios/manifest.webmanifest www/ && rsync -a --delete ../ios/icons/ www/icons/ && rsync -a --delete ../ios/fonts/ www/fonts/ && npx cap copy ios && cd ios/App && pod install
